summary: Every substantive claim in workstream A reproduced independently. Halmos: 98 tests, 43 PASS, 7 TIMEOUT (the same 5 P1 pow2 instances and 2 symbolic-deposit attempts), 48 of 48 reachability twins found witnesses, and per-instance statuses match proofs.json exactly. Five bugs I injected myself were each caught. Invariants: 8 of 8 pass at 200,000 calls each with 0 reverts (selector counts identical), and an instrumented rerun shows 196 paying settles and thousands of opens, deposits and withdraws, so the settle-pays branch is reached though only about 1% of settle calls pay. Mutation: the full slither-mutate rerun gives exactly 977 generated, 230 compile failures, 747 tested, 720 killed, 27 survived, 0 timed out, with the same 27 survivors (all re-run and surviving; I agree they are equivalent). Runtime bytecode of the cover and account implementations equals the deployed testnet code. Status is partial only because of small items: proofs files say P1 explored 162 paths while my run explored 160 (one instance, check_p1_two_deposits_d2p50, 9 vs 11 paths; path counts depend on solver timing); a hand-made fee-rounding mutant in quoteDeposit (line 277) survives the suite, a test gap in a view helper that slither's operator set does not generate (do not claim the suite catches all rounding changes); and the 689/58 first-pass split and the 9 literal mutants were not rerun individually. Safe to cite on /judge: halmos instance counts with the 5 timeouts stated as not proven, 8/8 invariants at 200,000 calls, 720/747 mutants killed with 27 equivalent survivors, with the P1 path count either corrected to 160 or dropped.

finalCheckObservations: proofs.md section 4 still says the full non-fork suite gives '166 passed, 0 failed (11 suites ...)': with QuoteDeposit.t.sol it is 168 passed in 12 suites.

P5's status reads 'proven for all paths (halmos, within the modelled-signature assumption)' in proofs.json, proofs.md and on /judge. My verdict for P5 was 'proven within stated bounds' (2 of 2 instances, 37 paths): the instances assume ecrecover returns the underwriter, the underwriter is not the zero address, the market or USDG, and a mock USDG. 'All paths' without that context reads like 'all inputs'. The /judge hint 'each instance fixes the deposit or the limit and leaves the rest symbolic' also does not describe the 2 P5 instances (everything is symbolic there), and README repeats it.

/judge's mutation tiles say 'Mutants 747, deliberate bugs injected' without saying the target is BondlineCover.sol only (SECURITY.md says so) or that 230 more generated mutants did not compile and are not counted; README's '720 of 747 mutants' has the same omission. Not wrong, but a reader may take 747 to cover all contracts.
README's P3 summary 'the user's net loss is the limit' lacks the condition SECURITY.md has: up to the cap. Past a 30% drop the net loss is larger. proofs.md states the condition.

SECURITY.md says 'Halmos can't take the principal and the limit both symbolic'. What I verified is two 900 s timeouts with the deposit symbolic and the limit fixed at 1000 bps (P2 and P3). The both-symbolic attempt (623 s on P2) is the builder's, and 'can't' is an explanation of timeouts, not a result.

The new quote fuzz fixes feeBps at 100 and the limit range at 500..2000: a quoteDeposit that hard-codes `amount * 100 / BPS` survives the whole non-fork suite. Randomising feeBps in the fuzz (as the invariant handler does) would kill it.

README's Backtest bullet says 'hypothetical covers on every Chainlink TSLA and AMZN round since 23 June'; BACKTEST.md says 51 covers per agent, one per market close, checked against every round. docs/data/backtest.json agrees with BACKTEST.md.

README says each item in the evidence list 'was re-run and checked by an agent that didn't build it (verdicts in verification/)'. True for all six bullets, but the A and B verdicts are partial, not pass; the reader has to open the files to see that.

All 11 contracts are partial matches on Blockscout (is_partially_verified true, is_fully_verified false; foundry.toml sets bytecode_hash to none), not only ProofOfCover as README's bullet implies. 'Every contract verified' is true; my bytecode comparison shows the deployed code equals contracts/src.

The two AIUC sources disagree on the seed: Fortune says '$15 million seed round'; Dealroom says 'It emerged from stealth in July 2025 with US$9.71M seed round led by Nat Friedman' and 'The raise brings the San Francisco-based startup's total funding to roughly $55 million'. README and /judge say $55M, made of a $15M seed (Fortune) and a $40M Series A (Dealroom); Dealroom's own figures ($9.71M + $40M) do not add to its $55M.

The survivor note for line 265 (proofs.json, proofs.md and /judge) says health() returns 'on two lines earlier'; the early return for status None is at line 257, eight lines before line 265. The reasoning holds, the count is off. README and SECURITY.md also say the Halmos proofs are 'on BondlineCover', but P5 (the market keeps no USDG) is a property of BondlineMarket.

/judge's invariant tile and README say '200,000 calls each'. forge counts every handler call, including early returns (proofs.md says so, /judge does not), and in my instrumented 1000 x 200 run 196 of 18,405 settle calls paid (about 1.1%), with opens 10,689, deposits 9,311, withdraws 11,972 and trades 1,922. The number is accurate as 'calls'; it is not 200,000 state-changing actions.

proofs.md says 'P1 after a withdrawal is covered for all limits by the p1_after_withdraw_fixed_* instances'. Reading the tests, that holds for one concrete deposit (123,456,789 at a 1% fee), one concrete withdrawal (20,000,000 units after a prior loss of 0 or 10,000,000) and a symbolic limit and loss. The instances where the withdrawal amount is symbolic (p1_after_withdraw_pow2_*: deposit 2^27, zero fee, concrete limit) are six: the limit-1 bps one passed and the five others timed out.

docs/TECHNICAL.md section 2 (outside the results paragraph I was asked about) says 'payout ≤ reserve always holds'. That is the design argument (cap rounded down, reserve rounded up); what was actually run for it is P1 within stated bounds (13 of 18 instances proven, 5 timed out), the invariant campaign and the fuzz tests.

docs/demo-video.md (not in the checked list) ends the pitch with 'our scripted gap claim has already paid on-chain'. At the time of this check no Settled event exists on any of the four covers (claimsPaid 0 on each, head 128,523,749), so that line must wait for the 15:00 IST settle.

proofs.md and proofs.json say '691 and 693 killed, 56 and 54 survived' 'in the verifier's re-runs'. Those totals are implied, not measured: I re-ran the 58 first-pass survivors (29 + 27 survive in the replica of the first-pass tree, 27 + 27 in the current tree), not the 689 mutants the builder's pass killed, so they hold only if none of those would flip to survive. The measured, reproducible fact is that 2 (replica tree) and 4 (current tree) mutants the builder's pass left uncaught are killed by BondlineInvariants.
